As part of a contract with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC), I developed content for an e-learning module on the environmental determinants of communicable diseases.

## Project Overview

The primary goal of this module is to strengthen the implementation of a One Health approach across the EU. It aims to improve practitioners' understanding of the critical interconnection between the health of humans, animals, plants, and their shared environment.

## My Role

My contribution focused on developing the curriculum and creating the module.

## Key Topics Covered

* The core principles of the One Health approach.
* Impacts of climate change on the epidemiology of communicable diseases.
* Environmental drivers of zoonotic spillover.
* Integrated surveillance and response strategies.
